# Cinzel Decorative Bold

Vendored unchanged from Google Fonts, `ofl/cinzeldecorative/CinzelDecorative-Bold.ttf`.
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cinzeldecorative
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, included as `OFL.txt`.

Used as the client proportional font for the ornate inventory revision. Go Mono
remains the monospace face and missing-glyph fallback. This affects all client
proportional labels, including the launcher, rather than accepting untrusted
server-pushed font files. No network request is required at build or runtime.
